title: 第12章 妹妹第13章 顺手的事
content_zh:
红日高升，晨雾渐散。
一架掛著黑色帷幕的马车正缓缓驶出大乾宫。
宫门外，是一条贯穿整个帝京城的武皇大道。
跨过天子桥，穿过林荫路，很快就抵达了闹市区，转进到了西街。
再往前不远，就是神武將军府。
楚家自大乾五百年前开国时，便是大乾皇室麾下最精英的一支神兵，无论是打江山还是守江山，神武军都立下了赫赫战功。
可惜传到楚夏父亲这一代时，家世已经衰败，过去拥有百万雄师的神武军，如今也只剩下十万之眾，否则父亲未必会……
很快，马车便行驶到了神武將军府大门外。
夏紫萱看了楚夏一眼，只道：“马车会放缓速度，到西城门外大概需要一刻钟的时间。”
“我会赶上的。”
楚夏戴上龙渊卫面具，跳下马车，並未从大门进入將军府，而是绕行到了將军府的后院，翻墙进入。
府內的下人基本已经被遣散，后院的园许久无人打理，都荒废了很多。
“是……少爷嘛？”
一个处著拐棍的老者看见楚夏，哆嗦著走上前来问道。
楚夏摘下面具，露出真容。
“徐管家，你是怎么认出我的？”
这老者名叫徐庶，是在楚家兢兢业业当差了一辈子的老管家。
看到果然是楚夏，徐管家激动不已。
“老朽是看著少爷长大的，少爷的身形轮廓，走路姿態，老朽都记的一清二楚，又岂会认错。”
楚夏点了点头。

“徐管家，这些日子苦了你了，府上近况如何？可有受人欺负？”
徐庶摇了摇头：“將军虽死，余威犹在，那些宵小之辈倒是不敢轻易对將军府出手，只是……”
“只是什么？”
“府上的积蓄都用来抚恤神武军战死的將士，家底已经掏空，府上的日常用度都撑不住，又有人趁机散播將军府要倒台的谣言，家丁丫鬟们都跑了。”
楚夏眉头一皱：“朝廷下拨的抚恤款呢？”
“不知道，听都没听说过。”
没有？还是被截胡了？
楚夏眸中闪过一抹厉色，这事他必须要查清楚。
“白薇呢？在家吗？”楚夏问道。
“大小姐在家中，她已经很久没去书院读书了，少爷你是该去看看她，现在只有少爷你才能让小姐振作起来。”
楚夏不再多言，直接朝后宅走去。
很快，楚夏就来到一间环境清幽雅致的小院中。
他刚要敲门，就见屋门被推开，一个脸色白皙憔悴，瘦弱的仿佛风一吹就会飘走的少女走了出来。
四目相对，楚白薇先是愣了一秒，旋即露出一副无比惊喜的表情，猛的扑了上来，紧紧抱住楚夏。
“哥，你总算回来了，我就知道你不会丟下我不管的！”
楚夏拍了拍妹妹的单薄的后背，沉声道：“你怎么瘦成这样，不记得我对你说过的话嘛，无论发生什么事情，自己的身体才是最重要的。”
楚夏的母亲在生二胎时难產去世，如今父亲也不在，血亲就只剩下楚白薇一人。
楚夏在大乾宫里的时候，最放心不下的就是这个年幼的妹妹。
她才十三岁，本该是锦衣玉食的將军府大小姐，却突然遭遇如此大的变故，父亲在外战死，尸骨无存，兄长也失踪不见，了无音讯。
没有精神崩溃已经算是不错了。

楚白薇抹去眼泪，露出一口洁白皓齿衝著楚夏傻笑。
content_en:
The red sun rises high and the morning fog gradually disperses.
A carriage with black curtains was slowly driving out of Daqian Palace.
Outside the palace gate is a Martial Emperor Avenue that runs through the entire Imperial City.
After crossing the Tianzi Bridge and crossing the tree-lined road, we soon arrived at the downtown area and turned into West Street.
Not far ahead is the Shenwu General's Mansion.
Since the founding of the country five hundred years ago in Daqian, the Chu family has been the most elite magical army under the royal family of Daqian. Whether it is conquering the country or defending the country, the Shenwu Army has made great achievements.
It's a pity that by the time Chu Xia's father's generation came, the family had already declined. The Shenwu Army, which used to have millions of troops, now only has 100,000 left, otherwise his father might not...
Soon, the carriage arrived outside the gate of General Shenwu's Mansion.
Xia Zixuan glanced at Chu Xia and said: "The carriage will slow down and it will take about a quarter of an hour to get to the west city gate."
"I'll catch up."
Chu Xia put on the mask of Long Yuanwei, jumped off the carriage, and did not enter the general's mansion through the gate. Instead, she went around to the backyard of the general's mansion and climbed over the wall to enter.
Most of the servants in the mansion have been dismissed, and the garden in the backyard has not been taken care of for a long time, and it is very deserted.
"Is it...young master?"
An old man on crutches saw Chu Xia and walked up to him tremblingly and asked.
Chu Xia took off her mask and revealed her true face.
"Butler Xu, how did you recognize me?"
This old man's name is Xu Shu, and he is an old housekeeper who has worked diligently in the Chu family all his life.
Butler Xu was very excited when he saw that it was indeed Chu Xia.
"I have watched the young master grow up. I remember the young master's figure and walking posture clearly. How can I admit his mistake?"
Chu Xia nodded.
"Butler Xu, I've been through a lot of trouble these days. How are things going at home? Are you being bullied?"
Xu Shu shook his head: "Although the general is dead, his power is still there. Those young people dare not take action against the general's mansion easily, but..."
"Just what?"
"All the savings in the house were used to pay for the soldiers who died in the Shenwu Army. The family's financial resources have been emptied, and the daily expenses of the house cannot be maintained. Some people took the opportunity to spread rumors that the general's house was about to fall. All the servants and maids ran away."
Chu Xia frowned: "Where is the pension allocated by the imperial court?"
"I don't know, I've never heard of it."
No? Or was it intercepted?
A sharp look flashed in Chu Xia's eyes, he had to find out about this matter.
"Where is Bai Wei? Are you at home?" Chu Xia asked.
"The eldest lady is at home. She hasn't gone to the academy to study for a long time. Master, you should go and see her. Only you, the young master, can cheer up the lady now."
Chu Xia said no more and walked directly towards the back house.
Soon, Chu Xia came to a small courtyard with a quiet and elegant environment.
Just as he was about to knock on the door, he saw the door being pushed open, and a girl with a pale and haggard face, as thin as if she would float away in the wind, came out.
When their eyes met, Chu Baiwei was stunned for a second, then showed an expression of great surprise, rushed forward, and hugged Chu Xia tightly.
"Brother, you're finally back. I knew you wouldn't leave me alone!"
Chu Xia patted her sister's thin back and said in a deep voice: "Why are you so thin? Don't you remember what I said to you? No matter what happens, your body is the most important."
Chu Xia's mother died in childbirth when giving birth to her second child. Now that her father is gone, Chu Baiwei is the only blood relative left.
When Chu Xia was in Daqian Palace, the thing she was most worried about was her young sister.
She was only thirteen years old. She was supposed to be the eldest daughter of the general's palace, but she suddenly encountered such a big change. Her father died in the battle and his body was not found. Her brother also disappeared and there was no news.
Not having a nervous breakdown is pretty good.
Chu Baiwei wiped away her tears and smiled stupidly at Chu Xia with her white teeth.
